name: Elara
description: A feature-rich WhatsApp bot with a refreshed feminine identity.

ELARA_PANEL_MODE.description: Keep the Render/Heroku web panel available for browser-based connections.

ELARA_PANEL_KEY.description: Optional legacy adapter key; the public browser panel uses an isolated session cookie.

ELARA_AUTO_START.description: Enable hosted auto-start after the provider credentials are configured.

ELARA_PROVIDER.description: Connection mode: whatsapp, telegram, or both.

WHATSAPP_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number with country code for non-interactive first pairing.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional Telegram bot token used by the Telegram connection card.

STARTUP_PASSWORD.description: Optional startup password for interactive mode; keep it secret.
